page_title: ATM 3-1 RMA | Atletico Madrid v Real Madrid 24/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) makes an awful challenge on his opponent and can count himself very lucky that the referee didn't issue a red card.
90+3' Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes just wide of the right post. Terrific solo effort, though.

90+1' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) pounces on the cross into the centre of the box, but hangs his head in shame after sending his header well wide of the left post when the keeper was on his backside.
90+1' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90+1' Javier Alberola Rojas blows the whistle, Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is penalised for a foul.
88' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
87' The substitution is prepared. Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Samuel Lino.
86' Substitution. Jose Maria Gimenez did his best and is replaced by Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid).
85' Javier Alberola Rojas has a clear sight and sees a foul from Joselu (Real Madrid).
84' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) takes it short.
84' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out for a corner. Real Madrid can continue in their attacking effort.
82' That's the end of the game for Alvaro Morata, who is replaced by Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid).
81' Real Madrid failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
81' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Real Madrid force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
81' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.

80' Saul Niguez (Atl. Madrid) commits a rough challenge and Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Real Madrid, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
79' David Alaba (Real Madrid) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.

78' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to place a shot into the roof of the net, but Jan Oblak makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory. Corner kick. Real Madrid will have an opportunity.
77' Kepa Arrizabalaga leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid).

76' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Atl. Madrid.
73' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag.
72' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) works the corner short.
72' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. Real Madrid have a corner.
70' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to make a change. Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) replaces Toni Kroos.
68' The corner from Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) is hurriedly cleared.
67' Ferland Mendy (Real Madrid) earns the yellow card.
65' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Cesar Azpilicueta (Atl. Madrid) is coming onto the pitch as Nahuel Molina cannot continue after picking up an injury.

65' What an opportunity! Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) picked the ball up and fired a projectile of a shot from long range which threatened the goalkeeper. The shot went painfully close to the left post!
64' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
63' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

63' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear. The referee points to the corner flag and Real Madrid will take a corner.
63' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. The ball goes out of play. Real Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
60' Ferland Mendy (Real Madrid) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
60' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
58' Nacho Fernandez (Real Madrid) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Javier Alberola Rojas saw the whole situation.
57' Here is a change. Eduardo Camavinga is going off and Carlo Ancelotti gives the last tactical orders to Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid).
57' Carlo Ancelotti decides to make a substitution. Fran Garcia will be replaced by Ferland Mendy (Real Madrid).
57' A substitution has been made. Lucas Vazquez goes off and Nacho Fernandez (Real Madrid) comes on.
54' Mario Hermoso (Atl. Madrid) latches on to the corner kick inside the box, but his header crashes against the crossbar! The goalkeeper would have been helpless.
54' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner.
54' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Atl. Madrid.
50' Javier Alberola Rojas blows for a foul after Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
50' The resulting corner from David Alaba (Real Madrid) comes to nothing.
49' The ball is cleared after Rodrygo (Real Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The linesman points to the corner flag, Real Madrid are going to take it.
46' 3 - 1 Goal! A nice lofted pass into the box by Saul Niguez is pounced on by Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid). His close-range header flashes past Kepa Arrizabalaga and into the right of the goal. 3:1.
46' Diego Simeone has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Axel Witsel comes on the pitch for Koke (Atl. Madrid).
46' Half-time substitution. Luka Modric (Real Madrid) is replaced by Joselu.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
45+2' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
45+1' Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) takes out his opponent with a horrific tackle and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) is booked for saying more than Javier Alberola Rojas was willing to tolerate.
44' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
44' David Alaba (Real Madrid) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

43' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Real Madrid.
43' Dangerous play by Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid). Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle for a foul.
40' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
40' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) picks up a short pass and immediately fires a shot towards the bottom left corner from distance, but Jan Oblak hardly has to move and makes a very easy save.
38' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) heads on.

35' 2 - 1 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot into the bottom left corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Jan Oblak. 2:1.
33' PENALTY APPEAL after Rodrygo (Real Madrid) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.

31' Saul Niguez (Atl. Madrid) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a low strike towards the middle of the goal. Kepa Arrizabalaga guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.

31' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball low to the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
30' Corner kick. David Alaba (Real Madrid) is ready to send the ball into the box.

30' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. Real Madrid force a corner. They send men into the box.
29' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

29' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball is out of play. Atl. Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner.
28' Atl. Madrid are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Atl. Madrid.
25' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Javier Alberola Rojas no option but to blow his whistle.
24' David Alaba (Real Madrid) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Rodrygo, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
22' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) pounces on the rebound on the edge of the box but his wild shot goes high over the crossbar.
22' David Alaba (Real Madrid) takes the corner with a short pass.
22' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is out of play. Real Madrid win a corner kick.
21' Mario Hermoso (Atl. Madrid) commits a rough challenge and Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle for an infringement.

18' 2 - 0 It's a goal! Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) bravely launches himself at a cross from Saul Niguez and gives Kepa Arrizabalaga no chance with a close-range bullet header into the bottom right corner. 2:0.
16' The resulting corner from Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
15' David Alaba (Real Madrid) takes a long run up and smashes the free kick at goal, but the defensive wall bravely blocks the effort. Real Madrid will take a corner kick.
15' Mario Hermoso (Atl. Madrid) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Real Madrid.
12' It looks like Koke (Atl. Madrid) saw red with that tackle. Javier Alberola Rojas won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
12' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) received a pass out of defence and immediately attempted a long-range shot, but a defender bravely blocked the effort.
10' Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) powers a header just wide of the right post following a cross into the middle of the box.
10' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
9' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. Good work from Atl. Madrid as they win a corner.

8' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
7' A snap shot from distance by Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) after a precise pass is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
4' 1 - 0 Goal! Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) ran onto a clever lofted pass from Samuel Lino and easily beat the keeper with a header into the bottom right corner from close range. 1:0.
2' The resulting corner from Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
2' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. Atl. Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
1' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) sends a long ball forward to Rodrygo, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is out of play. Atl. Madrid will have a throw-in.
1' The first half has started.
Real Madrid will kick-off.
Javier Alberola Rojas is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
